2026_primary.fact: Previous Elections page links "Unofficial Results (DEM)" and "(REP)" (unofficial.results.dem/rep.030326.pdf): scanned ES&S "Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS", county totals with Absentee/Early Voting/Election Day columns, "21 of 21 ED", footer "Election Summary - 03/03/2026 10:05 PM" on each page (printed run time on election night); Last-Modified 09 Mar 2026 13:15 GMT. Also Unofficial Totals (reconciliation forms, Last-Modified Mar 4 and Mar 5). No unofficial precinct report for this election is linked or found by site search; only official reconciliation and audit files otherwise.

rationale: Only the 2026 primary is determined (LATER: county-totals summary printed 10:05 PM election night, no precinct report posted). One determined election gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS at low confidence.
